narrative: Feast's CVE-2026-56121 is the precipitating first instance: a CVSS 9.3 unauthenticated RCE where the gRPC registry hands a base64-decoded feature-view body to dill.loads() before any auth check. That confirms the thesis premise that the ML attack surface has dropped into the data-and-metadata plane, where any registry trusting serialized objects on the wire is a code-execution endpoint.
remaining_gap: Needs a second, distinct named project to draw its own CVSS >=9.0 deserialization CVE on an ML registry or feature-store endpoint; today supplies only the first instance.
